cohort: 13,366 women delivering live singleton infants between 2013 and 2017 in Tongzhou district of Beijing, China
finding: Compared with IOM recommendations, GWG above Intergrowth-21st standards or the Chinese reference was associated with higher risks of GDM and GDM-related adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: GWG above either Intergrowth-21st standards, IOM recommendations, or the Chinese reference was associated with cesarean delivery.
